info.title: JobFind gateway HTTP API
info.description: Generated from executable request contracts. JSON only; unknown fields and invalid types are rejected, never silently coerced or removed. Response extensions remain allowed for the legacy migration. Operational endpoints, Socket.IO and legacy /api/* routes are documented separately in docs/http-contracts.md.

post.description: Modern microservice endpoint; legacy fallback routes are outside this contract. Requires permission job:manage; resource ownership checks still apply. Non-admin callers must belong to an active, approved company. Paid posting requires a current active, approved company even for ADMIN. With an Idempotency-Key, quota, new post, events and original response are committed atomically. Replay returns the initial 201 snapshot, not current moderation state, and rechecks current company membership/approval without spending quota. Keys must not be deleted while retries are possible. A new deadline must be in the future; omitted create deadline defaults to 30 days on the first accepted attempt.

post.description: Modern microservice endpoint; legacy fallback routes are outside this contract. Requires permission job:manage; resource ownership checks still apply. Non-admin callers must belong to an active, approved company. Paid posting requires a current active, approved company even for ADMIN. With an Idempotency-Key, quota, new post, events and original response are committed atomically. Replay returns the initial 201 snapshot, not current moderation state, and rechecks current company membership/approval without spending quota. Keys must not be deleted while retries are possible. A new deadline must be in the future; omitted create deadline defaults to 30 days on the first accepted attempt. Only expired, non-removed source posts in the caller company may be reposted. Copies the current detail into a new PS3 post, retaining the source featured flag and charging the matching quota. Original post is unchanged; new post requires moderation. Replays do not reread mutable source content.

put.description: Modern microservice endpoint; legacy fallback routes are outside this contract. Requires permission job:manage; resource ownership checks still apply. Non-admin callers must belong to an active, approved company. New editors must submit expectedRevision from jobManageGet.editRevision. Server checks it under post/detail locks before writes and before no-op detection; mismatch returns 409 with conflict=true and no write/events. Success returns data.editRevision for the accepted state. Optional only for compatibility with old clients, which remain unprotected. This body precondition is not HTTP If-Match or an idempotency key; never retry by silently refreshing the revision.

get.description: Modern microservice endpoint; legacy fallback routes are outside this contract. Requires permission job:manage; resource ownership checks still apply. Non-admin callers must belong to an active, approved company. Private current job read, including PS1/PS2/PS3/PS4. Non-admin access is restricted to the current approved company, rechecked with the job in one database statement; out-of-scope and missing IDs both return 404. ADMIN may inspect other companies. Returns raw classification codes and an opaque editRevision for guarded updates, not Allcode labels or AI internals. Missing/null revision means the client must not submit a guarded edit. PS3 means awaiting review, not proof a worker is processing. Cache-Control: private, no-store. Does not change the public jobGet visibility policy.
